body:
Greg's word (2026-11-25 ~03:33Z, via Engram::Asistant #2684, relayed by Fable2 TermAl #7772), verbatim: „NIE!!!”. This answered the plan to rerun w-6ea6 Fix8's Windows FULL (Central test-0d4ba2d4, 12/12 PASS on d8309928) after Engram refused its verification record on work_revision (a label-only revision 5->6 after a deferred first delivery; Engram defect w-8d0243f80d1a).
Rule:
- Do NOT schedule, queue or launch a repeat of a gate that has PASSED, on any host, just because its record delivery failed.
- The existing run stays untouched as the evidence; Engram (or the host) recovers its use through a supported path.
- Scheduler (Opus2) withdrew the queued rerun at 03:34Z, before any launch.
